advisories.mechanism: a lower EVM call gas limit lets a caller partially execute a precompile and error at a chosen point without reverting already-written state; also a liveness vector
withheld at disclosure; the advisory states no workaround exists for chains using precompiles, so upgrading was the only remediation path
